title: Haunting Adeline
author: H.D. Carlton
summary: Extremely dark stalker romance with graphic violence and non-consent. For experienced dark romance readers only.

title: Twisted Love
author: Ana Huang
summary: Brooding, emotionally unavailable hero with a dark past falls for his best friend's sister. Moderate dark themes with steamy content.

title: Corrupt
author: Penelope Douglas
summary: A revenge-fueled dark romance with morally gray characters, power games, and an intense enemies-to-lovers dynamic.

title: Icebreaker
author: Hannah Grace
summary: A lighthearted sports romance between a hockey player and a figure skater. Minimal darkness, moderately steamy.

title: Credence
author: Penelope Douglas
summary: Taboo, isolated-setting romance with significant age gaps and multiple love interests. Features explicit content and morally complex dynamics.

title: Vicious
author: L.J. Shen
summary: A cruel rich-boy romance with class warfare, bullying, and an intense enemies-to-lovers arc. Emotionally brutal hero.

title: King of Wrath
author: Ana Huang
summary: Billionaire arranged marriage romance with a commanding hero and strong heroine. Light dark themes, plenty of steam.

title: Punk 57
author: Penelope Douglas
summary: Secret identity pen-pal romance that turns into a volatile enemies-to-lovers story with bullying and deception.

title: Devious Lies
author: Parker S. Huntington
summary: A dark deception romance where lies unravel between two people with hidden agendas. Emotional manipulation and trust issues.

title: In a Holidaze
author: Christina Lauren
summary: A sweet, lighthearted holiday romance with a magical twist. No dark content — pure feel-good romantic comedy.

title: Den of Vipers
author: K.A. Knight
summary: Extremely dark reverse harem with graphic violence, explicit content, and morally bankrupt antiheroes. No limits.

title: Empire of the Vampire
author: Jay Kristoff
summary: Dark epic fantasy with vampires, religious themes, and graphic violence. Not a romance-primary story but contains dark romantic elements.

title: Binding 13
author: Chloe Walsh
summary: An emotional sports romance dealing with domestic abuse and trauma. The romance is slow-burn and tender, but the backstory is heavy.

title: Pestilence
author: Laura Thalassa
summary: One of the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse spreads plague across the world in this dark paranormal romance with captivity themes.

title: Violent Delights
author: Natasha Knight
summary: A brutal arranged marriage dark romance with themes of captivity, control, and violence. Very dark power dynamics.

title: The Deal
author: Elle Kennedy
summary: College sports romance with a fake-dating setup. Deals with past sexual assault sensitively. Mostly lighthearted with emotional depth.

title: Kingdom of the Wicked
author: Kerri Maniscalco
summary: Dark fantasy romance with demons, witchcraft, and murder. Slow-burn enemies-to-lovers with morally gray hero. Violence throughout.

title: Thoughtless
author: S.C. Stephens
summary: An emotionally raw love triangle between a woman, her boyfriend, and a rock star. Centers on infidelity and emotional turmoil.

title: Bully
author: Penelope Douglas
summary: A high school bully romance where the boy next door turns tormentor. Explores emotional cruelty, social humiliation, and reconciliation.

title: Filthy Rich Boys
author: C.M. Stunich
summary: A dark academy reverse harem with rich, entitled boys and a heroine who fights back. Class warfare and power games.

title: Throne of Glass
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: A young adult dark fantasy with an assassin heroine. Contains violence and loss but romance is sweet. Spice increases in later books.

title: From Blood and Ash
author: Jennifer L. Armentrout
summary: A dark fantasy romance with vampiric creatures, forbidden love, and graphic violence. Features a possessive hero and hidden identity twists.

title: Beautiful Disaster
author: Jamie McGuire
summary: A volatile college romance with an aggressive, possessive hero. Themes of jealousy, co-dependency, and underground fighting.

title: Ugly Love
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: A friends-with-benefits romance hiding deep emotional trauma. Dual timelines reveal devastating backstory. Emotionally heavy, very steamy.

title: Verity
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: A psychological thriller with dark romantic elements. Features disturbing manuscript revelations, violence, and morally ambiguous characters.
